subject: Music Production
title: Sampling in Electronic Dance Music
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Sampling in Electronic Dance Music.

hook.text: Chicago house music was born when DJs sampled disco records and looped their rhythms over drum machines.

buildup.text: Detroit techno producers sampled industrial sounds and Kraftwerk to create a futuristic aesthetic.

discovery.text: Jungle and drum-and-bass producers chopped breakbeats at extreme speeds, creating frantic new rhythms.

twist.text: Many iconic EDM tracks use the same classic breaks, yet they sound completely different from each other.

climax.text: Electronic music's entire history is built on sampling, remixing, and reinterpreting existing sounds.

punchline.text: Dance music was built by looping other people's records.

quiz.question: How did Chicago house music originate?
options: DJs sampled disco records and looped them over drum machines
